messages:
Carmen (Sales): Heads up 1 Nimbus asked for a joint co-sell pilot. Requirements: Redwood Private reachable from their AWS (VPC peering), SAML SSO, static egress IPs for firewall allowlisting, 90-day audit log retention, and a 6-week trial. They also want a simple pricing estimate and a list of tech risks. Can we triage?

Alex P (Eng): Need load profile to size GPUs and batching. Also: longest expected sequences? Any multimodal assets?

Carmen (Sales): Partner says chat-only, ~300 token avg, steady 25 rps with 2x spikes to 100 rps for demos (10m windows). No multimodal.

Samir (Platform): That's reasonable. For pilot we can stand up a small dedicated pool (2x T4/A10 equiv) with autoscale to handle demo spikes. Main asks: (1) partner AWS account id + peering CIDR (2) confirm whether they require our control plane to be in their VPC or hosted + peering.

Leah T (Partnerships): Nimbus prefers our hosted control plane but needs private peering for data egress control. They want to avoid installing anything.

Nora (Security): Security checklist: 1) SAML metadata for SP or IdP, 2) data residency confirmation, 3) KMS BYOK vs. Redwood-managed keys, 4) evidence for 90d log retention (we can provide export scripts). If they want BYOK, prepare for extra steps (KMS key policy + cross-account permissions).

Carmen (Sales): On pricing: Nimbus asked for pilot discount and clarity on transition to a paid co-sell. Suggestion: one-time pilot fee $5k + capped usage at $2k equivalent, then overage. Post-pilot, aim for a committed Dedicated quote. Thoughts?

Samir (Platform): That pilot pricing seems fine for pre-sales. Engineering deliverables: Pilot runbook + acceptance criteria + handoff checklist for partner enablement. I'll draft the runbook and include network templates and a telemetry header schema.

Alex P (Eng): For SAML, we can share an SP metadata snippet. Also need the customer's Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL and their EntityID. Example SP metadata we use: 

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://auth.redwood.example/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Location="https://control.redwood.example/saml/acs" Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

And sample provisioning CLI for runbook: 

```
# provision pilot tenant
rwctl tenants create --name "nimbus-cosell-pilot" --region us-west-2 --plan dedicated-pilot \
  --peering-cidr 10.60.0.0/16 --egress-ips 54.12.34.56,54.12.34.57,54.12.34.58 \
  --saml-sp-metadata-file nimbus-sp.xml
```

Leah T (Partnerships): I'll send Nimbus a short network form asking for: VPC ID and CIDR, peering subnets, allowed outbound ports, and point of contact. Also scheduling a tech sync Thu 11am PT.

Nora (Security): I'll run their short security questionnaire. If BYOK is requested: request KMS key ARN and a key policy or grant allowing cross-account decrypt/encrypt. BYOK typically adds ~3 business days to setup. Also prepare SOC2 artifacts and log retention export scripts.

Carmen (Sales): Great. Please prioritize questionnaire turnaround; partner wants security answers before the Thu sync. Leah, send the network form ASAP.

InfraBot: Ticket RWF-4888 created: pilot provisioning template queued. Owner: @Samir. ETA 48h.

Samir (Platform): Action items I have: (1) draft pilot runbook and acceptance criteria, (2) publish egress IP list and sample security configs, (3) quick committed estimate for a 3-node dedicated pool for post-pilot quoting. Will update this thread when done.

Alex P (Eng): Telemetry note: ensure we pass partner and tenant identifiers in headers for tracing. Proposed headers: `X-Redwood-Partner: nimbus` and `X-Redwood-Tenant: nimbus-pilot`. We'll also add a small flag to enable verbose request logs for the pilot tenant.

Leah T (Partnerships): Sent network form + SAML sample to Nimbus. Meeting invite sent for Thu 11am PT with demo agenda.

Carmen (Sales): I'll draft the pilot SOW and pricing note and loop in Legal for a short SOW. Nora, can you attach SOC2 evidence packets to the SOW?

Nora (Security): Yes, attaching SOC2 reports and retention confirmation. Will try to return questionnaire answers tomorrow EOD.

Samir (Platform): Logged tasks: https://jira.internal/browse/RWF-1129 (cosell pilot). Will post runbook draft in 36h.

Carmen (Sales): Thanks everyone. Let's aim to have the runbook + security answers before Thu so the sync is purely technical and we can get Nimbus into pilot quickly. :+1:

Leah T (Partnerships): Noted. I'll follow up if Nimbus has any blockers.
